name: relation-view-more
goal: Show four relationships per module type and reveal four more without changing scope or other groups

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Each module type in Used In and Uses starts with four rendered catalog rows; View More appends four more independently, disappears at the end, and preserves navigation scope. Changing entity, tab or revision resets batches.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing shared relationship browser matrix uses at most two rows per type. Extend its shared fixture with nine of every module kind, and the same matrix with partial/final batch, independent type, keyboard focus and reset assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed browser matrix at 24cfcb3d892b310354723dce75afc7601830625d failed four initial entries per type; preserved record d02409eb4f32a52cbfc8f4e0ab56daa4b5ed93e45e947b09cecc33ca2aed1aec and before screenshots.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Extended ExplorerCatalogItems with optional four-row batches and HarnessAction; EntityRelations keys independent groups by navigation scope. Commit e16911522dddddef681957c50c613475121b1f0a.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen browser command passed at e16911522dddddef681957c50c613475121b1f0a in desktop, tablet and mobile at tip and historical scopes. Green checkpoint preserved; no test edits between red and green.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
